name: DeepSeek
summary: DeepSeek is an assistant for writing, coding, and questions. A business user can draft a note or ask it to explain a technical step.
paragraphs: DeepSeek is an assistant for writing, coding, and questions. A business user can draft a note or ask it to explain a technical step.
whyItMatters: Use it for a draft or an explanation of a technical step, and check the result before you use it.
